verdict.rationale: Epic's editor-scripting docs say users can "Create your own Asset import and management pipelines" and cut repetitive tasks. The Python scripting docs add automating asset management tasks like LOD generation and building pipelines that tie the editor to other 3D applications, which covers the core story of scripted, hands-off import. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of import hooks or post-import callbacks, import presets or settings templates, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of batch-import automation.
